summary: The pre-push hook gives the "is it covered" question 300 s by default, up from 60 s, and counts that time against an agent's wait

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers, schema-version changes or data rewrites.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes; no coordinated member upgrade required.

compatibility.detail: Only the default of ST_EVIDENCE_STATUS_TIMEOUT changes; an explicit value still wins. The hook still refuses an agent's push it cannot show is covered.

downtime.detail: No daemon or client restart; the hook runs the base branch's copy, so it takes effect at merge.

manual.detail: No operator actions or configuration changes required.
